full_judgment: 23. It has been noticed that the acquisition proceeding was in respect of more that 70 acres of land involving many persons including the plaintiffs and notice under 5(1) was a pre-requisite for initiating acquisition proceeding. Service of public notice being an official act, a presumption is available under section 114(e) of the Evidence Act that it has been regularly performed unless the contrary is proved. Notice under 5(3) being a personal notice, a denial by the owner is prima facie evidence of non-service. Therefore, consideration is bound to be different when allegation is made as to non-service of both the aforesaid notices.
